title: Tools for Monitoring Performance Counters and Events

facts.text: Windows Performance Monitor collects and views performance data from counters and trace events.
Windows Event Viewer collects and views server events from Applications and Services Logs.
Logman tool creates and manages event trace sessions and performance logs from command prompt.
PowerShell Get-WinEvent cmdlet views server instance events recorded in Windows Event Logs.
PerfView focuses on Event Tracing for Windows information for performance issue isolation.
Microsoft TraceEvent Library provides classes for controlling providers and parsing ETW events.
